# Planning to watch Spooky in Love? Save this release schedule If you love K-dramas that blend humor, horror, crime and mystery, then tune in to *Spooky in Love*, tvN's latest drama based on the 2011 film *Spellbound* \(also known as *Chilling Romance*\)\. It follows the wealthy CEO of the luxury Reina Hotel, who seems to be living a normal life until a big secret is revealed\. *Spooky in Love *airs on tvN in South Korea while international viewers can watch it on Netflix\. The K-drama has only twelve episodes in total, with each chapter expected to run for at least an hour\. The premiere episode is out for streaming and fans will get Episode 2 in just a few hours\. As for the cast, fan favorite Park Eun-bin appears as the female lead alongside Yang Se-jong, who plays the male lead\. While Park's Cheon Yeo-ri owns a luxurious hotel, Yang's Ma Gang-wook is an accomplished prosecutor\. The two first meet through a series of unexpected incidents connected to murder investigations\.
